_comment: Which template SET VERSIONS a human has approved, and at which exact bytes (ADR-1005, REQ-07).
A template edit is its own decision. Without this file, editing a clause and committing it
would put new wording in front of customers on the next publish, and the only approval in
the chain would be the per-venture one -- which approves a VENTURE fact set, not the prose.
The venture owner would be approving words nobody reviewed as words.
It lives OUTSIDE products/legal/data/ on purpose. Everything in data/ is inside the render
input hash, so recording an approved hash there would change the hash it records -- a file
that can never agree with itself.
